scope.verification: CLGauge source semantics checked against the retained bundle matching the accepted pool source-reproduction review digest; no fresh chain observation.

limitations: The maintainer accepted qualified Level 3 review of these source-scoped CL overload semantics on 2026-09-15. Acceptance covers explanatory knowledge and enables no claim writer.
The gauge implementation is an ABI/source template. Calls target the validated dynamic gauge for the pool, not its registry implementation address.
The source checks below describe authorization of these overloads; current identity, claimability and exact-call simulation are separate operation preconditions.

calls.caller: The caller must have tokenId in its own gauge stake set; an ERC-721 approval does not satisfy this check.
calls.coverage: Settles gauge rewards for the supplied staked tokenId.

calls.caller: Only the gauge's configured voter may call this overload. A wallet calling getReward(itsOwnAddress) directly fails the voter check.
calls.coverage: Iterates all tokenIds in the supplied account's gauge stake set and settles each position to that account. Use the voter-mediated claim route described by incentives-gauges-rewards.

settlement: Both overloads use _getReward: update position rewards, clear a positive stored reward before transferring rewardToken to the recipient, and emit ClaimRewards. A zero reward produces no transfer or ClaimRewards event in this path.
